one_liner: Gorgias offers a REST API with Basic Auth and OAuth2 for helpdesk automation.
gating_notes: API keys are available on all Helpdesk plans but require admin access. OAuth2 apps require a partner account and approval.
oauth_details: OAuth2 is available for creating apps via the partner program, requiring client_id and client_secret.
